verdict.rationale: Granola documents a mobile app (iOS and Android) for AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings, with transcription in 17 languages on mobile. The workspace offers search and Chat across all meetings. However, no evidence explicitly says mobile-captured notes sync into the same searchable workspace as desktop notes; that is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that mobile recordings sync into the shared workspace, evidence that mobile notes are searchable alongside desktop notes, and independent hands-on corroboration of mobile in-person capture (community reports cover the Apple Watch and phone-call flow, not in-person sessions).

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: Granola for mobile lets you take AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings and outbound phone calls.
Granola supports 31 languages on desktop (macOS and Windows) and 17 languages on mobile (iOS and Android).
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
search through your meeting notes, find specific topics discussed in past meetings
